blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for houses in Sperling-Duthie. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Sperling-Duthie, Burnaby: 24 houses listed at the end of October 2026 and 4 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 17%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. By listings that is number 4 of 35 Burnaby communities for houses.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Burnaby total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in Sperling-Duthie fell from 31 in June to 24 in October (−22.6%), and 14 sold across the 5 months. In October the community held 5.6% of Burnaby’s 430 houses listed.
Houses or condos and townhomes in Sperling-Duthie?

blocks.text: Sperling-Duthie home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

20 houses sold in Sperling-Duthie with a median price of $1,850,250 (the middle half sold between $1,673,750 and $2,013,750), taking a median of 35 days to sell at 94.5% of the last list price; 0% sold above list. They had a median $615 per square foot, a median year built of 1974 and a median lot of 7,431 square feet.

blocks.source: Source: Paragon, the MLS® system used by Jared’s office, closed sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026. Pending sales are not counted. Median means the middle price, so half sold for more and half for less. Sold vs list is the sale price as a percentage of the last list price. A figure is shown only where at least 5 homes sold, and a row is shown only with 5 or more sales; with fewer, one sale would be the whole figure.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Sperling-Duthie?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 24 houses listed in Sperling-Duthie. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Sperling-Duthie a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses in Sperling-Duthie had a sales ratio of 17%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Sperling-Duthie from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 14 houses sold in Sperling-Duthie over those 5 months, out of 251 in all of Burnaby.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Sperling-Duthie?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

faq.q: What did houses in Sperling-Duthie sell for?
faq.a: 20 houses sold in Sperling-Duthie between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,850,250.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Sperling-Duthie?
faq.a: The median was 35 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 94.5% of the last list price (0% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
